title: check_dependency_graph.check() return-value contract
description: This dict is never serialized to JSON on disk or over a wire by the current implementation -- it is an in-memory Python dict, described here via JSON Schema vocabulary as a precise type notation for anyone calling check() programmatically. This is the one genuinely closed shape in the whole contract: it mirrors the literal `return {...}` in check_dependency_graph.check(), so additionalProperties is false and every key is required.

missing_targets.description: Sorted list of (prompt_id, missing_dependency_id) pairs -- a depends_on entry pointing at an id not present in the catalog.

self_dependencies.description: Sorted list of prompt ids that list themselves in depends_on.

tracked_cycles.description: Strongly-connected components of size > 1 that are fully covered by an open, range-matching RISK_REGISTER.json entry.

untracked_cycles.description: Strongly-connected components of size > 1 not covered by any open risk-register entry -- these are the ones that fail the check.

risk_register_present.description: Whether a risk_register argument (dict) was passed to check() at all -- true even if it has zero entries.
